_comment: Queue for the weekly automated article (.github/workflows/weekly-article.yml).
The generator takes the FIRST entry whose `status` is `queued`, writes it,
and flips that entry to `published` with the date. It never invents a topic:
an empty queue means no post that week, which is the correct behaviour.
A blog with nothing to say should say nothing.
Add topics by appending objects here. `question` is the search intent the
article should answer, phrased the way a real person would type it.
`angle` steers the piece so two related topics do not produce near-duplicate
pages, which is what gets a site flagged for scaled content.

topics.title: Is Mediation Required Before Divorce in Florida?
topics.question: is mediation required before divorce in florida
topics.angle: Florida Family Law Rule 12.740 and local circuit practice: when a court must refer a contested case to mediation, when a judge can waive it (domestic violence history, inability to pay), and what that means for someone who has not filed yet. Describe the rule, never advise on whether a specific case qualifies.

topics.title: Mediation vs. Arbitration: What Is the Difference?
topics.question: difference between mediation and arbitration
topics.angle: A mediator facilitates and decides nothing; an arbitrator hears evidence and issues a decision. Cover who controls the outcome, whether the result binds, cost and timeline differences, and which disputes each suits. Keep it comparative rather than promotional.

topics.title: What Mediation Costs Compared to Going to Court
topics.question: is mediation cheaper than going to court florida divorce
topics.angle: An honest cost comparison. Use this practice's published rates for the mediation side. For the litigation side describe how retainers and hourly billing work in general terms and cite ranges only to a named public source. Do not invent figures or predict what any particular case will cost.

topics.title: How to Prepare for a Mediation Session
topics.question: how do i prepare for divorce mediation
topics.angle: Practical preparation: documents worth gathering, thinking through priorities versus positions, what to expect emotionally, and how to use the time well. Process guidance only, no advice on what terms to seek.
